name: App
description: A full application, planned the way the industry makes software: idea, requirements, screens, look, mockups, prototype, tech plan and tasks. The AI builds it last.

intake.label: What should your app do?
intake.help: The problem it solves and who uses it, in your own words.

steps.name: Idea
steps.describe: A one-page brief: the problem, who uses the app, what it must do and what it must never do.

steps.name: Requirements
steps.describe: Every feature as a user story (As a ___, I want ___, so that ___) with its "done when" checks.

steps.name: Screens
steps.describe: The sitemap and user flows: every screen and how you move between them.

steps.name: Look
steps.describe: Three or four visual directions, then the picked one as a design system (colours, type, buttons).

steps.name: Mockups
steps.describe: Every screen drawn in the picked look.

steps.name: Prototype
steps.describe: A clickable fake app made from the mockups.

steps.name: Tech plan
steps.describe: Stack, data model, API, folders and tests, with a plain-words summary on top.

steps.name: Tasks
steps.describe: The build split into small tickets in order, each tied to its user stories and screens.

steps.name: Build
steps.describe: The AI builds the app ticket by ticket and tests each one against its "done when" checks.

steps.name: Ship
steps.describe: Run it, package it, then an installer or a deploy.
